name: Circular Showcase Slider
description: Pseudo-3D curved carousel of tall image cards that lean toward the center, rotated by drag, arrow keys or buttons, with a glass modal detail view on click.
contents: Eyebrow subtitle and uppercase main title
Row of image cards arranged in a perspective arc
Previous and next arrow buttons and a hint line
Detail modal with image, eyebrow, title, description, tags and a call-to-action button
behavior: Cards are repositioned with GSAP tweens when the track rotates by drag, arrow keys or buttons
Dragging rotates one step per threshold distance
Clicking a card opens a blurred glass modal, the track blurs behind it
Escape or backdrop click closes the modal
editableByProps: Slides with title, description and image, all headings, hint and modal text and tags
Drag sensitivity, tween duration and easing

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the card arc shape, heights, depth or tilt

needsCodeEdit.where: w-[240px] class on the card div inside slides.map
Ambient glow divs at the top of the root element
STYLES constant and the 400ms timeout in closeModal

fixed: Listens for ArrowLeft, ArrowRight and Escape on window while mounted and removes the listeners on unmount
Root is at least one viewport tall with its own background and hides overflow
Needs 11 slides to fill every slot of the arc
Card heights and tilt follow the fixed 11-slot POSITIONS table
